sentences.translation: back-end mist
The school is over.
I'm going home with my friend Hanako.
"How was your day today?" Hanako asks.
"It was a pleasure. I enjoyed sports classes." I say.
"Yes, Hanako always has fun."
Two people walk home from school.
I walk around this place every day.
"Oh, my throat is dry," I say.
"Yes, I'll drop by the convenience store," says Hanako.
Two people enter a convenience store together.
The inside of the store is cool.
"What shall I buy?"
"I'll buy you a drink and a joke."
We choose the funny.
There are various kinds of jokes.
I'll buy potato chips and chocolate.
The drink picks juice.
I'm leaving the convenience store.
I'll walk again.
I eat a geek while walking.
It's delicious.
"Oh, this is the crossroads. I'll break up here," says Hanako.
"Yes, I'll see you again," I say.
Hanako turns right.
I turn left.
Two people wave.
"I'll see you again,"
"Bye bye. I'll see you at school tomorrow."
Today's return was a good day.
I'll go home with my friends tomorrow.
